headline: Pacific Airshow takes to the skies above the Gold Coast – in pictures
context: Aerobatic feats and big military jets drew crowds of plane-spotters to Surfers Paradise beach for the return of the Pacific Airshow over the weekend. First held in California in 2016, the event came to Queensland in 2023 but was cancelled last year due to damage caused by Cyclone

sources.name: The Guardian
